pages.title: Iron Singularity
pages.text: A mountain of iron, crushed until it collapsed into a single point. It is still recognisably iron: grey, cold and faintly magnetic. Holding it feels like holding the core of a planet, and it tugs at nearby metal.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Singularity Compactor iron ingots until their atoms could no longer stay apart. The pressure crushed them past degeneracy into a single dense point.
